summary: Per the fdev budgets-v1 decision on FS-GG/.github#4645, hosted GitHub runners run only the public-circle fixture; licensed tactical/rifleman geometry stays on Home. run-hosted-benchmark.sh builds each arm from this harness with only src/Scene, src/Scene.SvgBrowser and src/KeyboardInput taken from a named 40-hex producer revision (calibration: the clean committed HEAD), then runs three fresh-browser trials in one job with alternated arm order (baseline-first, candidate-first, baseline-first) and record order. Chromium headless shell runs with --disable-gpu, pinned to one logical CPU, server on another; analysis refuses mixed browser/affinity environments. Records: shared symbol 100/250/500 and expanded 100 times static, camera-only, 10%/50% sparse motion and per-tick 10% churn, with faction colour, health bar and selection outline; 20 warm-up plus 100 measured ticks; sustained 250-unit churn with consecutive rAF intervals. The timed span is the fixture's F# document construction plus synchronous Replace; oracles and export are outside it. The statistic is the median over trials of candidate/baseline per-trial medians; A/A calibration sets tolerance max(2 x spread, 10%) over records above 10x clock resolution; 500 is saturation and reported but not gated. Fixture builds are not byte-reproducible, so sourceSha256 and producer revision, not manifest digest, identify producers. Budgets B1-B8 are not evaluated hosted; no GPU, speedup or licensed-glyph claim. The measured tolerance lives in the owning issue/run evidence.
title: Hosted SVG software benchmarks are relative, public-fixture only and never judge budgets
